lines.japanese: 「ＨＥＹ！　ＹＯ！　テンション上がってるかい土曜の夜のボーイズェン・ガールズ！」
lines.english: “HEY! YO! You feeling good, Saturday-night boys 'n' girls?!”

lines.japanese: それでも、司会進行なんて任されたら率先して弾けないわけにはいきません。

lines.japanese: 袖の裏（男子トイレ）から清々しい登場を果たした俺は、ＦＭ放送のパーソナリティ気取りで、胡散臭い早口と巻き舌の低音をマイクに載せて飛ばしました。

lines.english: “Yeahhh! Alexander, yeaaah!”

lines.english: “I'm drinking! Drinking till I puke!”

lines.english: Three people hung on as I started in top gear: the organizer, our boss; tonight's guest of honor, Kinako; and the notorious party crusher, ERIKO.

lines.japanese: なんだかんだ言っても俺は、このひと達のこういう、楽しむことに対して前向きな姿勢が大好きです。
lines.english: Whatever I might say, I love the way these people make a positive effort to enjoy themselves.

lines.japanese: そして、えー、周囲に流されずマイペースを貫けるカケルくんや日和子さんが羨ましくもあります。
lines.english: And, uh, I also envy Kakeru and Hiyoko for being able to follow their own pace without getting swept along.

lines.japanese: 「タマイズミさー、おまえ相ッ変わらず売れない本出して、版元に迷惑かけてんのー？」
lines.english: “Hey, Tamaizumi. Still putting out books nobody buys and making trouble for your publisher?”

lines.japanese: 「ええー、鳳さんこそ、相変わらず自由奔放な仕事ぶりだそうでー。方々から評判は聞いてますよー」
lines.english: “Ohhh, Mr. Ohtori, I hear you're as free and easy in your work as ever. Your reputation reaches me from all sorts of places.”

lines.japanese: ていうか、あんたら巷の評判はいいから俺の話を聞けＹＯ！
lines.english: Never mind your reputations, listen to me, YO!

lines.japanese: 「それでは場も暖まってきたところで！　いよいよ望月紀奈子さんの壮行会を始めたいと思います」
lines.english: “Well then, now that we've warmed up! It's time to begin Kinako Mochizuki's send-off!”

lines.japanese: 「題して！　輝け、第三回がんばれ紀奈子・三度目の正直スペシャルパーティーっ！」
lines.english: “Entitled: Shine On! The Third Go-for-It-Kinako, Third-Time's-the-Charm Special Party!”

lines.japanese: 「三回とか三度目とか言うなよ」
lines.english: “Quit saying third and third time.”

lines.japanese: 紀奈子さんのささやかな訴えは、群集の拍手と喝采に呑まれて消えました。
lines.english: Kinako's modest plea disappeared beneath the crowd's applause and cheers.

lines.japanese: 「えー、それでは乾杯の音頭を！　はい、ここはやはり戦地に赴く義勇兵・望月紀奈子さんにお願いいたしま、ＳＨＯＷ！」
lines.english: “Uh, now for the toast! Of course, we'll ask our brave volunteer heading off to war, Kinako Mochizuki, to get this SHOW on the road!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、私？　じゃあ乾杯」
lines.english: “Oh, me? Well, cheers.”

lines.japanese: 「早っ！」
lines.english: “That was fast!”

lines.japanese: グラスを掲げようとして前のめりに空振りする出席者続出。
lines.english: Several guests leaned forward to raise their glasses and swung at empty air.

lines.japanese: 「あ、もっとこう、ゆ～っくり振りかぶった方がいい？」
lines.english: “Oh, should I take a slooower windup?”

lines.japanese: 「モーションはどうでもいいです。じゃなくてほら、あるでしょ一言二言。受験に対する意気込みとか」
lines.english: “Never mind the motion. You know, a word or two. How you feel about the entrance exams.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、意気込みかあ……」
lines.english: “Oh, how I feel...”

lines.japanese: 「えーとー、本命のところは引っかけのコツを掴んできたので今年はもう騙されないと思います。あと、第二志望の学食はデミグラスソースが美味しいので今からハンバーグ定食が楽しみです」
lines.english: “Ummm, I've figured out the tricks they use at my first choice, so I don't think they'll fool me this year. And the cafeteria at my second choice has good demi-glace sauce, so I'm already looking forward to the hamburger-steak lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「意気込み、初々しくねぇー」
lines.english: “Nothing fresh-faced about that enthusiasm.”

lines.english: “More like the dignity of a veteran.”

lines.japanese: 「ベテランとか貫禄とか言うなよ」

lines.japanese: 「は、はいはい、それじゃかんぱーい！」
lines.english: “R-right, right. Well, cheeers!”

lines.english: Before things got out of hand, I exercised my authority as emcee and hurriedly got the party started.

lines.japanese: 乾杯の宣言をすると、和洋中の料理が無節操に並んだテーブルの上で、薄いガラスの触れあう威勢の良い音が続きます。
lines.english: At my declaration, thin glasses clinked briskly above a table where Japanese, Western, and Chinese dishes mingled without restraint.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介」
lines.english: “Shuusuke.”

lines.english: While the guests served themselves food and began casual conversation, Karuo Karube, age thirty-five, left his seat and sidled over, unfolding a small scrap of paper.

lines.japanese: 「はあ。なんすかマスター、またろくでもなさそうな微笑みをたずさえて」
lines.english: “Yeah? What is it, Boss? Another smile that doesn't bode well.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿を言うな、喜べ。アドリブに弱いおまえのため、この狩男があらかじめ宴のプログラムを組んでおいてやったのだ。これに従って議事進行すれば滞りなくことが運ぶはず」
lines.english: “Don't be ridiculous. Rejoice. Knowing how poorly you improvise, I, Karuo, have prepared a party program for you. Follow it to conduct the proceedings, and all should go smoothly.”

lines.english: “Huh? We're just drinking, eating, and making noise. What's to conduct? Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 折り目だらけの白いＯＡ用紙には、箇条書きの毛筆体が仰々しく印字されています。
lines.english: On the much-creased white printer paper, a list was pompously printed in a calligraphy font.

lines.japanese: １．壮行会開会のことば

lines.english: “Indeed. Mochizuki's speech, in other words.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。じゃあ、いまここまで終わったわけですね。で、次は……」
lines.english: “I see. So we've finished this much already. And next...”

lines.english: “Over already?!”

lines.english: “Whaaat, that's the end?! Is that okay? Is this really okay?!”

lines.english: 7. No holds barred! Filthy-words-only word chain (to hell with broadcast standards!)

lines.english: “Hmph, yielding to the authorities? But Shuusuke—no, hollow doll who has forgotten his dreams—remember this.”

lines.english: “Life is pornography!”

lines.english: “Throwing me under the bus?!”

lines.english: “Aaah!”

lines.english: To prove I'd been falsely accused, I unhesitatingly presented Karuo Karube's life plan to the jury.

lines.english: Then into four, then eight, finally turning it into—mathematically speaking—256 pieces of confetti, which she tossed behind her without looking back.

lines.english: Ignoring the fluttering white snow, Hiyoko resumed her interrupted conversation and smile.

lines.japanese: つわものだ……。

lines.english: “Tch. Did you see that woman's brutality, Shuusuke?”

lines.japanese: マスターは反省の色もなく、抑圧されたリビドーを骨付きチキンにぶつけていました。
lines.english: Without a trace of remorse, the boss was taking out his repressed libido on a chicken drumstick.

lines.japanese: 「これはもはや言論封殺だ、思想弾圧だ、焚書坑儒だ。おそらくあのプログラムを実行されると、やつにとって都合の悪い問題が生じるに違いない」
lines.english: “This is silencing speech, suppressing thought, burning books and burying scholars. That program must create some problem inconvenient to her.”

lines.english: “Um, isn't there some ethics board somewhere that could regulate your very existence, Boss?”

lines.english: “Hmm... What's this, Shuusuke? You're remarkably moral today. A group date, and not a spark of spirit. Short of male hormones, are you?”

lines.english: “Really? I thought Tamaizumi's snake eyes had scared your bullfrog into shrinking.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、いやいや、そんなことは……」
lines.english: “Hahaha, no, no, nothing like...”

lines.japanese: ない……ような、あるような。
lines.english: ...that. Or maybe there was.

lines.japanese: えー、まー。もともと他人の顔色を窺いながら生きてきた男の子っすから、俺。
lines.english: Uh, well. I've always been the kind of boy who lives by reading other people's moods.

lines.english: Glancing over, I saw Hiyoko chatting happily with Kinako.

lines.english: Really, what a waste. She has such a nice smile.

lines.english: “You understand, Shuusuke. Pedal to the floor.”

lines.english: I raised the pitch and volume of my voice and clapped several times.

lines.japanese: さわさわと会話が引いて、一同の視線が集まります。ほんのちょっぴりスタア気分。
lines.english: Conversation rustled away, and everyone's eyes gathered on me. A tiny little taste of stardom.

lines.japanese: 「ねーマスター、鮭茶漬けないの？　あと漬物」
lines.english: “Hey, Boss, got any salmon rice with tea? And pickles.”

lines.japanese: ……注目してない子もいました。
lines.english: ...One boy wasn't paying attention.

lines.japanese: 「はい、そこ静粛に。えー、それではー、只今よりプログラムナンバー５番、嬉し恥ずかし自己紹介を行いたいと思いまーす」
lines.english: “Quiet over there, please. Well then, we'll now begin item five: introductions, delightfully embarrassing!”

lines.japanese: 「自己紹介って……え、みんな知った顔なのに？」
lines.english: “Introductions... Huh? But we all know each other.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。コンパとやらには、そのようなオープニングセレモニーが必要だと聞いている」
lines.english: “Indeed. I understand that a group date requires such an opening ceremony.”

lines.japanese: 「というわけでそちらの……はい、本日の主役を務めるお嬢さんからどうぞ！」
lines.english: “So, over there... Yes, the young lady serving as tonight's star, please begin!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、私？　望月」
lines.english: “Oh, me? Mochizuki.”

lines.japanese: 「短かっ！」
lines.english: “So short!”

lines.japanese: 思わず俺は、紀奈子さんの目の前の空想ホームベースに上半身スライディングで飛びこみました。
lines.english: Before I knew it, I'd thrown my upper body into a slide toward the imaginary home plate in front of Kinako.

lines.japanese: 「あ、下の名前も言った方が良かった？　紀奈子、紀奈子。望月紀奈子」
lines.english: “Oh, should I have given my first name too? Kinako, Kinako. Kinako Mochizuki.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、うーん……どーすかね審査委員長、ただいまの自己紹介は」
lines.english: “No, hmm... What do you think, Chairman of Judges? That introduction?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、光るものはあるが荒削りだ。致命的なまでにロマンが足りんな」
lines.english: “Indeed. There's a glimmer of talent, but it's rough. A fatal lack of romance.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、ロマン！　ロマンっすよ紀奈子さん！」
lines.english: “Yes, romance! Romance, Kinako!”

lines.japanese: 「ろまん？」
lines.english: “Romance?”

lines.japanese: 「そうですほら、こうスカートの裾をつまんで片足を後ろにちょん……とか、もっとノーブルでロイヤルでやんごとない自己紹介を！」
lines.english: “Exactly. You know, take the hem of your skirt, put one foot behind the other... A nobler, more royal, more aristocratic introduction!”

lines.japanese: 「うちの実家、苺農家だよ？」
lines.english: “My family's strawberry farmers.”

lines.japanese: 「王侯将相いずくんぞ種あらんや。氏素性は問いません。胸にロマンがあれば、ひとは誰でも殿上人」
lines.english: “Are kings, nobles, generals, and ministers born to their station? Birth and background don't matter. With romance in your heart, anyone can be a courtier.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ぜんぜん意味わかんない」
lines.english: “Ahaha, I don't understand any of that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃーよー、そんな言うなら、ちょっと手本見してみーよ」
lines.english: “Then hey, if you've got so much to say, show us how it's done.”

lines.japanese: 「む、そう来たか……では委員長、よろしくお願いいたします」
lines.english: “Hmm, so that's how it's going to be... Chairman, if you please.”

lines.japanese: 「よかろう」
lines.english: “Very well.”

lines.japanese: 俺が頭を下げると、マスターはまぶたを伏せながら、恭しく手を胸の前へ置きました。
lines.english: When I bowed, the boss lowered his eyelids and solemnly placed a hand before his chest.

lines.japanese: 「ごきげんよう、軽部狩男です。職業は愛の探求者。趣味は非合法すれすれのロマンス、特技はマウントポジションからのロマンス。尊敬する人物はロマンスの神様、好きなレスリングのスタイルはグレコローマンです」
lines.english: “Good evening. I am Karuo Karube. My profession is the pursuit of love. My hobby is romance on the edge of illegality; my specialty, romance from the mount position. My role model is the God of Romance, and my favorite wrestling style is Greco-Roman.”

lines.japanese: 「ブラボー！　素晴らしい！」
lines.english: “Bravo! Wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ロマンって単語むやみに連呼してるだけじゃん」
lines.english: “No, you're just repeating ‘romance’ for no reason.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、最後の方ただのダジャレだったさ」
lines.english: “And the last part was just a pun.”

lines.japanese: 「いいや素晴らしい！　さすがですマスター、ロマン輝くアレキサンダー！　そのまばゆさに俺はもうロマンチックが止まりません！　胸が胸が、苦しくなる苦しくなる！」
lines.english: “No, wonderful! That's our boss! Romance shines at Alexander! It's so dazzling I can't stop the romance! My heart, my heart, it aches, it aches!”

lines.japanese: 「はァ、あんなんでいいのか、おまえのロマンは」
lines.english: “Wow, so that's enough for your romance, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええ、まあ、言葉の定義はひとそれぞれっすから……」
lines.english: “Uh, well, yes. Everyone defines words differently...”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君、どうして目を逸らして曖昧に微笑んでるの？」
lines.english: “Shuusuke, why are you looking away and smiling vaguely?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ……自分、Ｊボーイっすから……」
lines.english: “No... I'm a J-boy, you see...”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、そもそもシュウちゃんにロマンの判定ができんの？」
lines.english: “Actually, can Shuu even judge romance?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや。これがなかなかどうしてロマンチストなのよね俺」
lines.english: “Now, now. Believe it or not, I'm quite the romantic.”
“Heh.”

lines.japanese: 「……え、日和子さん、ひょっとしていま笑いました？」
lines.english: “...Huh? Hiyoko, did you just laugh?”

lines.japanese: 「や、笑いましたよね。俺がロマンチストだって言ったら、失礼なことに吹きだしましたよね」
lines.english: “No, you did, didn't you? I said I was a romantic, and you rudely burst out laughing.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。笑いました。それがなにか」
lines.english: “Yes. I laughed. Is that a problem?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、なにも」
lines.english: “N-no, not at all.”

lines.japanese: ははは……正直な娘さんだこと……。
lines.english: Hahaha... What an honest girl...

lines.japanese: ちくしょう、逆襲してやる。
lines.english: Damn it, I'll get her back.

lines.japanese: 「ぃやっほう、みんな聞いて聞いてビッグニュース！　日和子さんが笑ったぞう、俺のシケギャグで！　あのひと、ちょっとユーモアのセンスおかしくなーい？」
lines.english: “Yahoo! Listen, everyone, big news! Hiyoko laughed! At my lame joke! Isn't her sense of humor a little weird?”

lines.japanese: ははは、悔しそうだこと。
lines.english: Hahaha, she looks frustrated.

lines.japanese: 「え、マジで？　たまひよ、千歳とケンカしてんじゃなかったの？」
lines.english: “Huh, seriously? Tama-chick, weren't you fighting with Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「べ、べつに、そういうわけでは……」
lines.english: “N-no, it isn't... like that...”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、違うみたいですよー。だって日和子さんは、とてもほがらかな笑顔を俺に向けてくださいました」
lines.english: “Yes, apparently not. Hiyoko turned such a bright, cheerful smile on me.”

lines.japanese: 「向けてませんっ」
lines.english: “I did not!”

lines.japanese: 「でも笑ったのは確かなんでしょー」
lines.english: “But you did laugh, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、それはつまり恋愛感情の萌芽だな。大いなるロマンスも最初は小さな笑顔から始まるものだ」
lines.english: “Oh, the first budding of love, then. Even a great romance begins with a little smile.”

lines.japanese: 「……いえ、間違えました。やっぱり笑ってません」
lines.english: “...No, I was mistaken. I didn't laugh after all.”

lines.japanese: 「容疑否認！？」
lines.english: “Denying the charge?!”

lines.japanese: 「なんですか？　私が笑ったっていう物的証拠でもあるんですか？」
lines.english: “What? Do you have any physical evidence that I laughed?”

lines.japanese: 「しかも小学生レベル！」
lines.english: “And at grade-school level!”

lines.japanese: 「てか証拠もなにも！　ねえ、日和子さんが笑ったの、見てましたよね皆さん！？」
lines.english: “What do you mean, evidence?! Come on, everyone. You saw Hiyoko laugh, didn't you?!”

lines.japanese: 「え、ごめん、見てはいなかった」
lines.english: “Huh? Sorry, I wasn't looking.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。いちいちそんな見てない」
lines.english: “Yeah. Not watching every little thing.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！　なんて使えない集団！」
lines.english: “Whaaat?! What a useless bunch!”

lines.japanese: 「笑ってませぇーん」
lines.english: “I didn't laaaugh.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そんな、生徒指導室に呼びだされたナマイキ盛りの非行少年みたいにそっぽ向いちゃって……」
lines.english: “Oh, turning away like a delinquent boy called to the guidance office at the height of his mouthiest phase...”

lines.japanese: 「千歳ー、じゃあもう一回笑わせてみーよ。ほら、今度はうちら、ちゃんと見てっから」
lines.english: “Chitose, make her laugh again, then. We'll actually watch this time.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな！　笑うまいと身構えてる相手を笑わせるのが、いかに難しいことか！」
lines.english: “How can you ask that?! Do you know how hard it is to make someone laugh when they're braced against it?!”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君、嘆くのは失敗したあとでも出来るよ」
lines.english: “Shuusuke, you can moan after you've failed.”

lines.japanese: 「う、二浪のおねえさんにそう言われると説得力がある……仕方ありません、それでは」
lines.english: “Ugh, coming from a woman who's failed her exams twice, that's convincing... No choice, then.”

lines.japanese: 俺はこぶしを鳴らしながら日和子さんの真正面に立ちました。
lines.english: Cracking my knuckles, I stood right in front of Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「えー、参ります。よろしいですか」
lines.english: “Uh, here I go. Ready?”
“Sigh...”

lines.japanese: 全員の視線が集まると、日和子さんはがっくりうなだれてしまいました。恥ずかしいのか呆れているのか、落ちた前髪とその影が表情を隠していてそれは判別できません。
lines.english: As all eyes gathered on her, Hiyoko let her head drop. Embarrassed or exasperated? Her fallen bangs and their shadow hid her expression, so I couldn't tell.

lines.japanese: 俺は日和子さんの頭頂部を見下ろしながら口を開きました。
lines.english: Looking down at the top of her head, I spoke.

lines.japanese: 「えー、お題、『ロマンチックな自己紹介』」
lines.english: “Uh, the theme: A Romantic Introduction.”

lines.japanese: 「こんばんは、千歳鷲介です。真実の愛を歴史に刻むため、オーロラの見える国から白馬に乗ってやってきました」
lines.english: “Good evening. I'm Shuusuke Chitose. To inscribe true love in history, I came on a white horse from a land where the aurora shines.”

lines.japanese: 「職業はガラスの靴作り職人です。趣味は瞳の中の星を数えること、特技は香りが移るほどのハグ。口癖は語尾に『～ごらん』を付けること。将来の夢はワルツの似合う王子さま、好きな動物はペガサスです」
lines.english: “My profession is crafting glass slippers. My hobby, counting the stars in your eyes; my specialty, hugs long enough for our scents to mingle. My favorite expression is ‘won't you, my dear?’ My dream is to become a prince who looks right dancing a waltz. My favorite animal is the pegasus.”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、いま笑った？」
lines.english: “—Oh, did she laugh?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。ビミョーだけど、一応笑ったんじゃない？」
lines.english: “Yeah. A little iffy, but I guess that counts?”

lines.japanese: 「肩、プルッてしたしな」
lines.english: “Her shoulders gave a little shake.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ、どうやらペガサスがツボにはまったようだ」
lines.english: “Hmm, the pegasus seems to have hit the spot.”

lines.japanese: 「いやっほォォォーう！」
lines.english: “Yahoooooo!”

lines.japanese: 「フフフ、恥ずかしがることはないさ仔猫ちゃん。君が噛み殺すのは苦虫だけでいい。さあ、勇気を出して僕らにその素敵な笑顔を見せてごらん」
lines.english: “Hehehe, no need to be shy, kitten. The only thing you need to bite back is bitterness. Come, be brave and show us that lovely smile, won't you, my dear?”

lines.japanese: しかし日和子さんは俺から顔を背け、誰もいない空席を睨みながらこぶしを固めていました。
lines.english: But Hiyoko turned her face away from me, clenching her fists and glaring at an empty chair.

lines.japanese: 「♪わーらったー、わーらったー」
lines.english: “♪ She laaaughed, she laaaughed!”

lines.japanese: 「♪ひーよこさんがー、わーらったー」
lines.english: “♪ Hiyoko laaaughed!”

lines.japanese: 俺は英里子さんと一緒に、両手をぱたぱたと空駆ける天馬のようにはためかせながら、日和子さんを中心点とする華麗な円を描いて回りました。
lines.english: Together with Eriko, I fluttered both hands like a winged horse galloping through the sky and traced a graceful circle around Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「仕方ないじゃないですか！」
lines.english: “Can't help it!”

lines.japanese: すると日和子さん、顔を赤らめて逆ギレです。
lines.english: Then Hiyoko flushed and snapped back at us.

lines.japanese: 「辣韮が転がっても笑っちゃう年頃なんですっ」
lines.english: “I'm at that age where even a rolling shallot makes me laugh!”

lines.japanese: うわあ、微笑ましい言いわけだなあ。
lines.english: Wow, what an endearing excuse.

lines.japanese: ──で、まあ、とりあえずは自己紹介をちゃっちゃと済ませることになりました。
lines.english: —Well, anyway, we decided to get the introductions over with quickly.

lines.japanese: パターンＡ、アイドル風。
lines.english: Pattern A: Pop idol.

lines.japanese: 「やっぽーん！　宿木ゼミナール私立文系Ａクラス、望月紀奈子だよっ！　みんなたちー、今日は私のためにありがちゅー！　入学試験がんばります！　得意科目は道徳です！」
lines.english: “Hiyaaa! Private-University Humanities Class A at Yadorigi Prep, Kinako Mochizuki here! Thanksies, everyone, for coming for me today! I'll do my best on the entrance exams! My best subject is moral education!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ、紀奈子さんかわいー！　ぷりぷりプリティィィ！　」
lines.english: “Eeeek, Kinako, you're so cute! Pretty, pretty, pretttyyy!”

lines.japanese: パターンＢ、レディース系。
lines.english: Pattern B: Girl biker gang.

lines.japanese: 「押忍！　天神大学経済学科１年、日野英里子！　好きな乗り物は玉の輿！　ハンパなく飛ばして、てっぺん目指してくんで、そこんとこ４６４９！」
lines.english: “Yo! First-year economics at Tenjin University, Eriko Hino! My favorite ride is a rich husband! I'll tear it up all the way to the top, so don't you forget it!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ、英里子さんかっこいー！　ばりばりバイオレンスゥゥゥ！」
lines.english: “Eeeek, Eriko, you're so cool! Violent, violent, vioooolent!”

lines.japanese: パターンＣ、ただの無愛想。
lines.english: Pattern C: Plain unfriendly.

lines.japanese: 「美空学園２年Ｂ組、玉泉日和子。嫌いな男性のタイプは語尾に『～ごらん』を付ける王子さま。以上。もう会うこともないでしょう」
lines.english: “Class 2-B at Misora Academy, Hiyoko Tamaizumi. The men I dislike are princes who say ‘won't you, my dear?’ That is all. I doubt we'll ever meet again.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ、日和子さんつめたーい！　きんきんクールビューティィィ！」
lines.english: “Eeeek, Hiyoko, you're so cold! Ice-cold cool beautyyy!”

lines.japanese: パターンＤ、協調性に欠けるくん。
lines.english: Pattern D: Mr. Doesn't Play Well with Others.

lines.japanese: 「シュウちゃん、ちょっとタクアン取ってー」
lines.english: “Shuu, pass the pickled radish.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ、カケルくん唯我独尊ー！」
lines.english: “Eeeek, Kakeru, you're the center of the universe!”

lines.japanese: 「──って流れ壊すなよ、もぉぉぉ！」
lines.english: “—Don't wreck the flow, come ooon!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 文化祭に協力しないタイプの典型であるカケルくんは、自分勝手にほかほか湯気の立つ鮭茶漬けをいただいておりました。
lines.english: The very model of someone who wouldn't help at the school festival, Kakeru was selfishly enjoying his steaming salmon rice with tea.

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃないでしょ。なんなの。それが自己紹介なのキミは。キミの名前はタクアンか。木を見て森を見ずでおなじみの沢庵和尚か」
lines.english: “Don't ‘huh’ me. What's that? Is that your introduction? Is your name Takuan, like the pickles? The monk of can't-see-the-forest-for-the-trees fame?”

lines.japanese: 「いいじゃん。どうせ全員知ってるでしょ、俺のこと。タクアン取って」
lines.english: “Who cares? Everyone knows me anyway. Pass the pickled radish.”

lines.japanese: いやはや。日和子さんでさえ（一応は）ノッてくれたのに、さすがはカケルくんです。
lines.english: Good grief. Even Hiyoko had played along—technically. That's Kakeru for you.

lines.japanese: 「それはどうなの？」
lines.english: “Is that okay?”

lines.japanese: 「アリじゃない？」
lines.english: “Sure, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「ナシに決まってるでしょう。そんな付き合い悪い子はお母さん許しませんよ。さあ、元気よく皆さんにご挨拶なさい」
lines.english: “Of course it isn't. Mommy won't stand for such an antisocial boy. Now, greet everyone nice and loudly.”

lines.japanese: 「柳木原フレイムバーズ筆頭代理、鳳翔。趣味はヤンキー狩り、特技はチョークスラム。今日もこのあと、粋がってるチーム一個、潰しに行きます。苦手な人物は美空署少年課の岩間さんです。タクアン取って」
lines.english: “Acting leader of the Yanagihara Flame Birds, Kakeru Ohtori. My hobby is hunting delinquents; my specialty, the chokeslam. After this, I'm going to crush one more team that's getting cocky. Someone I don't get along with is Mr. Iwama in the Misora precinct's juvenile division. Pass the pickled radish.”

lines.japanese: 「まあっ、カケルくんが人前でちょっぴりアナーキーなパーティージョークを！」
lines.english: “My! Kakeru made a slightly anarchic party joke in public!”

lines.japanese: 感激した俺は、そばにあった漬物皿を両手で彼に差しだしました。
lines.english: Moved, I presented the nearby plate of pickles to him with both hands.

lines.japanese: 「上出来よ、カケルくん。さあ、お食べなさい。ポリポリ音を立ててお食べなさい」
lines.english: “Well done, Kakeru. Go on, eat. Eat with lovely crunching noises.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは喜んだ素振りもなく、あくびの出そうな動きでのっそりと箸を伸ばしました。
lines.english: Without showing any pleasure, Kakeru languidly reached out with his chopsticks, almost yawning.

lines.japanese: 「カケル」
lines.english: “Kakeru.”

lines.japanese: そのときマスターの重たげな呼びかけが入って、カケルくんは動きを止めました。
lines.english: At the boss's heavy call, Kakeru stopped moving.
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえの冗談は面白くない。イエローカードだ──」
lines.english: “Your jokes aren't funny. A yellow card—”

lines.japanese: マスターは真顔のまま、逆手に握ったフォークをぶすりと皿の上にたて、その先端に深々と刺さった黄色い獲物をカケルくんの目の前へ突きだしました。
lines.english: His face serious, the boss plunged a reverse-gripped fork into the plate and held the yellow prey deeply impaled on its tip before Kakeru's eyes.

lines.japanese: 「──なんちゃって」
lines.english: “—Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: ドスの利いた低音を付けたしたあと、ゆっくり唇を左右に広げます。
lines.english: Adding that in a menacing bass, he slowly spread his lips to either side.

lines.japanese: カケルくんは一瞬間を置いてから静かに笑いかえすと、マスターの手首を固く掴みイエローカードに横から食らいつきました。
lines.english: After a beat, Kakeru quietly smiled back, firmly seized the boss's wrist, and bit into the yellow card from the side.

lines.japanese: そして、串でも捨てるみたいにマスターの腕を払います。
lines.english: Then he brushed the boss's arm away like discarding a skewer.

lines.japanese: ぽり、ぽり、ぽり……臼歯がきざむ甲高いリズムは、朗らかなクリスマスソングにも埋もれずアレキサンダーに響きわたりました。
lines.english: Crunch, crunch, crunch... The high rhythm of his molars rang through Alexander, undrowned even by the cheerful Christmas songs.

lines.japanese: 「えー、はい、というわけで！」
lines.english: “Uh, yes! So then!”

lines.japanese: ぱん！　ぱん！　ぱん！　俺は負けじと手を叩いて対抗しました。
lines.english: Clap! Clap! Clap! I clapped my hands, refusing to be outdone.

lines.japanese: 「自己紹介もひととおり終わりましたところで、このままガンガン上げていきましょう！　トーンとかテンションとかボルテージとか、それはもう色んなものをガンガンにブチ上げていきましょう！」
lines.english: “Now that everyone's introduced themselves, let's keep turning it up! The tone, the energy, the voltage—let's really crank everything up!”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ、それでは続きましてプログラムナンバー８番、嬉し恥ずかし質問コーナー！」
lines.english: “Yes! Next, program item eight: questions, delightfully embarrassing!”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？　千歳君、６番と７番が抜けてるよ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Shuusuke, you've skipped six and seven.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、欠番です。公序良俗に反するため検閲削除させていただきました」
lines.english: “Oh, those numbers are vacant. Censored out for offending public order and decency.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｂｏｏｏ！　Ｂｏｏｏｏ──！」
lines.english: “Booo! Boooo!”

lines.japanese: 会場のごく一部から湧いたブーイングを無視して、俺は月曜朝の校長先生のように両手を後ろへ組んで前説を始めました。
lines.english: Ignoring the boos from one tiny part of the venue, I put both hands behind my back like a principal on Monday morning and began the preamble.

lines.japanese: 「えー、ごふん、皆さんよろしいですかー。古来より袖触りあうも他生の縁、などと申しましてー、えー、ごふん、我々もこの良き日にめぐり逢えた縁を大切に温めてゆきたいと……」
lines.english: “Uh, ahem. Everyone, are we ready? Since ancient times, even a brush of sleeves has been called a bond from another life. Uh, ahem. We too should cherish and warm the bond that brought us together on this fine day...”

lines.japanese: 「もう温まってるよー」
lines.english: “We're warm already!”

lines.japanese: 「てゆか、べつに今日はじめて会ったわけでもないしねぇ」
lines.english: “Besides, it's not like we met for the first time today.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、縁を持つということはぁ、言いかえれば『お互いを知る』ということです。そこでこのコーナーでは、えー、この機会に相手の内面を掘りさげ、相互認識という名の絆を深めましょうという……」
lines.english: “Uh, to have a bond is, in other words, to ‘know one another.’ So in this segment, we'll use this opportunity to delve into each other's inner selves and deepen the bond we call mutual understanding...”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。テレビのお見合い番組みたいな感じだね」
lines.english: “I see. Like a TV matchmaking show.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。昔はそういうのがあったんですか」
lines.english: “Oh. They used to have those?”

lines.japanese: 「ジェネレーションギャップ！」
lines.english: “Generation gap!”

lines.japanese: 「紀奈子さーん、やめなよ、そのオタっぽいリアクション」
lines.english: “Kinako, quit those nerdy reactions.”

lines.japanese: 「間接的バッシング！」
lines.english: “Indirect bashing!”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんかワタクシ指差されてますけど、無視して始めますよー。まずは最初の質問を、えーと……」
lines.english: “Uh, someone seems to be pointing at me, but I'll ignore that and begin. Now, the first question, let's see...”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、さっきから口数の少ないカケルくん！　どうぞ！」
lines.english: “All right, Kakeru! You haven't said much. Go ahead!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「えーと……シュウちゃん、さっきトイレ行ったけど手洗った？」
lines.english: “Uh... Shuu, you went to the bathroom earlier. Did you wash your hands?”

lines.japanese: 「そおいう、質問じゃ、なくて、さあ！」
lines.english: “That's! Not! The kind! Of question!”

lines.japanese: 俺は微笑みながらカケルくんの頭頂部を鷲掴みして、その口に無数のタクアンを詰めこみました。
lines.english: Smiling, I grabbed Kakeru by the top of his head and stuffed countless slices of pickled radish into his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「ばかっ！　カケルくんのばかっ、この黄色い大根マニア！　どこのお見合いでそんな色気のない質問が飛びだすっていうの！」
lines.english: “Idiot! Kakeru, you idiot, you yellow-radish maniac! What matchmaking party produces a question with so little romance?!”

lines.japanese: 「え……あの、洗ってないんですか手」
lines.english: “Uh... You didn't wash your hands?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: ふと気付けば、参加者一同が近接戦の間合いから離脱して俺はひとりぼっちでした。
lines.english: Before I knew it, every guest had withdrawn beyond close-combat range, leaving me all alone.

lines.japanese: 「な、なに言ってんすか皆さん！　めちゃめちゃ洗いましたよ。洗いざらい洗いましたよ。血で血を洗うように洗いましたよ。言っとくけど今日から俺の好きな動物は、ペガサス改めカニクイアライグマですからね！」
lines.english: “Wh-what are you saying, everyone?! I washed them like crazy! Made a clean sweep! Made a whole bloodbath of it! For your information, as of today my favorite animal isn't the pegasus. It's that little hand-washer, the crab-eating raccoon!”

lines.japanese: 「きったねーな千歳、早く洗ってこいって」
lines.english: “That's filthy, Chitose. Hurry up and wash them.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとの話聞けよオイぃぃ！」
lines.english: “Listen to me, dammittt!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ていうかね、ちょっと失礼じゃないですかアナタ方。洗う洗わない以前に、俺のつまんだ素敵なサムシングがそんなに汚いとおっしゃるんですか」
lines.english: “No, I mean, aren't you people being a little rude? Before we even get to washed or unwashed, are you saying the wonderful something I held is that dirty?”

lines.japanese: 「こらこら、言わせといて引くなよう」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, don't make me say it and then recoil.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、引くだろ」
lines.english: “No, we'd recoil.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは。最近の若い娘ときたら、まったくどんな想像をしたのやら」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. Young ladies these days—what on earth did they imagine?”

lines.japanese: 「してませんっ」
lines.english: “I didn't imagine anything!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、無理無理。シュウちゃんのは想像を絶するからね」
lines.english: “No, impossible. Shuu’s defies imagination.”

lines.japanese: 「……え、ちょっと待って。なんでキミ、こういうときだけ嬉々として会話に入ってくんの。しかも、さも見たことあるかのように平然と」
lines.english: “...Hold on. Why do you only join in so happily at times like this? And so calmly, like you've seen it.”

lines.japanese: 「このまえ夢で見たから」
lines.english: “I saw it in a dream the other day.”

lines.japanese: 「夢が夢でありますように！」
lines.english: “May that dream be just a dream!”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね、たしか……うん、あの春巻きぐらいあった」
lines.english: “Let’s see. It was about the size of that spring roll.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶっ！」
lines.english: “Pff!”

lines.japanese: 「ひとが口に入れてる最中のもので例えないでくださいっ！」
lines.english: “Don't compare it to something I'm in the middle of eating!”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: なぜか俺が怒られてしまいました。
lines.english: For some reason, I got yelled at.

lines.japanese: まずいです。この流れはよろしくありません。どうやら鷲介くんがひとりで汚名をかぶるようです。
lines.english: This is bad. This isn't a good direction. Looks like young Shuusuke's going to end up with all the disgrace.

lines.japanese: 「あのう皆さん、提案なんですけど……そろそろ下ネタやめません？」
lines.english: “Um, everyone, I have a suggestion... Shall we stop with the dirty jokes?”

lines.japanese: 「え、やめるもなにも」
lines.english: “Huh? Stop? But...”

lines.japanese: 「おめーが振ったんじゃん」
lines.english: “You're the one who started it.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。だからこそ。ね、ほら、この辺どんどん下がってきてるし」
lines.english: “Yes. That's exactly why. See, things are sinking lower and lower here.”

lines.japanese: 「はいはいはい、上げてきますよー！　それじゃ次の質問いってみましょう、はい、どなたかございませんかー」
lines.english: “Yes, yes, yes, let's turn it up! Now, the next question! Anyone? Anyone?”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ先生！　ハイっ、ハイっ！」
lines.english: “Yes, teacher! Me! Me!”

lines.japanese: 「おおっ、暑苦しいほどに積極的な生徒がひとり！　はい、それじゃあ、とっても元気な狩男くん！」
lines.english: “Oh, one student with almost oppressive enthusiasm! All right, our very lively Karuo!”

lines.japanese: 「はい……ごほん……えー、女性チームの皆さんにお伺いしますが……」
lines.english: “Yes... Ahem... Uh, I'd like to ask the ladies...”

lines.japanese: 「パンツの色は、とか抜かしたらぶっ殺しますよー」
lines.english: “Ask what color our panties are and I'll kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか。千歳さんじゃあるまいし」
lines.english: “Surely not. He's not Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、千歳君そんなこと聞いたの？」
lines.english: “What? Shuusuke asked that?”

lines.japanese: 「こ、こらそこっ、私語は慎みなさいっ！　もう、ねえ、軽部狩男ともあろうお方がそーんな古典的なネタで打って出るわけないでしょうに」
lines.english: “H-hey, you two, no side conversations! Come on, a man of Karuo Karube's stature would never lead off with a joke that old.”

lines.japanese: 「ささ、マスター、質問の続きをどうぞ！」
lines.english: “Go on, Boss, finish your question!”

lines.japanese: 「禁止されたからもういい」
lines.english: “You've banned it, so never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「ええビンゴっすか！　パンツの色ビンゴっすか！　しかも予備の弾ナシっすか！」
lines.english: “That was it? Underwear color was it? And you had no second round in the chamber?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、予備の弾って」
lines.english: “What do you mean, spare ammunition?”

lines.japanese: 「や、だから予備の質問すよ。ブラジャーの色とか──」
lines.english: “A backup question. The color of their bras, perhaps—”

lines.japanese: 「ぼふっ！」
lines.english: “Bof!”

lines.japanese: どこからともなく、おしぼりが飛んできました。
lines.english: A damp hand towel flew in from somewhere.

lines.japanese: 「ち、違っ！　いまの質問、俺じゃなくて！」
lines.english: “N-no! That question wasn't mine!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえだろ」
lines.english: “No, it was.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。俺は弾を切らしていたからな」
lines.english: “Indeed. I was out of ammunition.”

lines.japanese: 「……あ、そうか俺だ」
lines.english: “...Oh, right. It was mine.”

lines.japanese: 「ばふっ！」
lines.english: “Baf!”

lines.japanese: どこからともなく、牛乳の染みこんだおしぼりが飛んできました。
lines.english: A milk-soaked hand towel flew in from somewhere.

lines.japanese: なにやら俺のキャラがどんどん確立しつつあります。しかし欲を言えば、ピエロはいいけど、おげれつ大王はいやです。いやなのです。
lines.english: My character seemed to be getting more firmly established by the minute. But if I could ask for one thing, clown was fine; Lord of Filth was not. It was not.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、提案なんですけど……もうホント、マジで下ネタやめません？」
lines.english: “Um, I have a suggestion... Seriously, really, can we stop with the dirty jokes now?”

lines.japanese: 「え、マジでもなにも」
lines.english: “Huh? Seriously? But...”

lines.japanese: 「おめーが引っぱってんじゃん」
lines.english: “You're the one dragging it out.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。だからこそ。ね、ほら、この辺どんどん下がってきてるし」
lines.english: “Yes. That's exactly why. See, things are sinking lower and lower here.”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ先生！　ハイ質問！　ハイっ、ハイっ！」
lines.english: “Yes, teacher! A question! Me! Me!”

lines.japanese: 「うわー、なんかまたやな予感がするけど指さなきゃ先に進まないから仕方なく──はい、狩男くん」
lines.english: “Wow, another bad feeling, but we won't get anywhere unless I call on you, so reluctantly—yes, Karuo.”

lines.japanese: 「はい……ごほん……えー、女性チームの皆さんにお伺いしますが……」
lines.english: “Yes... Ahem... Uh, I'd like to ask the ladies...”

lines.japanese: 「スリーサイズは、とか抜かしたらぶっ殺しますよー？」
lines.english: “Ask for our measurements and I'll kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「えええー？　まさか、ねえ、軽部狩男ともあろうお方がそーんな古典的なネタで打って出るはずないでしょうに」
lines.english: “Whaaat? Surely not. A man of Karuo Karube's stature would never lead off with a joke that old.”

lines.japanese: 「ささマスター、質問の続きをどうぞ！」
lines.english: “Go on, Boss, finish your question!”

lines.japanese: 「禁止されたからもういい」
lines.english: “You've banned it, so never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「ビンゴっすか！　スリーサイズもビンゴなんすか！　しかもまた予備の弾ナシっすか！」
lines.english: “Bingo again! Measurements this time! And again you had no second round?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、予備の弾って」
lines.english: “What do you mean, spare ammunition?”

lines.japanese: 「や、だから予備の質問すよ。乳輪の直径とか──」
lines.english: “A backup question. The diameter of their areolas, perhaps—”

lines.japanese: 「ごふぁっ！」
lines.english: “Gofah!”

lines.japanese: どこからともなく、箸置き入りのおしぼりが飛んできました。
lines.english: A hand towel with a chopstick rest inside flew in from somewhere.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううっ……分かっているのに、お約束を振られるとつい反応せずにはいられないこの体質が憎い……」
lines.english: “Ughhh... I hate this habit of mine. I know what's coming, but when someone feeds me the familiar setup, I can't help answering...”

lines.japanese: 「どうだ玉泉君。千歳鷲介という人間がよく分かっただろう」
lines.english: “Well, Tamaizumi? You understand what sort of person Shuusuke Chitose is now, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、おおよそは」
lines.english: “Yes, roughly.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、わりと面白かったよ、カルテット漫才」
lines.english: “Well, the quartet comedy act was pretty funny.”

lines.japanese: 「カルテット！？」
lines.english: “Quartet?!”

lines.japanese: 「うん。新メンバーのひよちゃんも、初めてとは思えないぐらいリーダーと息ぴったりだったさ」
lines.english: “Yeah. New member Hiyo, you were so in sync with the leader, you'd never think it was your first time.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ちょ……なに言ってるんですか！　ぜんぜん合ってませんよ、めちゃめちゃ不協和音じゃないですか」
lines.english: “Huh? Wait... What are you talking about?! We weren't in sync at all. It was total dissonance!”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、喋り方まで誰かさんに似てきたね」
lines.english: “Hehe, even the way you talk's getting like somebody's.”

lines.japanese: 「腐ったミカンの方程式！」
lines.english: “One rotten orange spoils the bunch!”

lines.japanese: 「そんじゃ千歳ー、もういいよ、質問コーナー終わりー。次行こ、次ぃ」
lines.english: “Well, Chitose, that's enough. Questions are over. Next, next.”

lines.japanese: 「待ってくれ。最後にひとつ、真面目な質問をさせてほしいのだが」
lines.english: “Wait. I'd like to ask one last serious question.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、はい、ぜったい真面目な質問じゃないのは分かってますけど、止めても無駄そうなんでどうぞ」
lines.english: “Oh, yes, I know it absolutely won't be serious, but stopping you seems pointless, so go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、本当に真面目な質問なのだ。ちょっと小耳に挟んだのだが、最近の若い女性はブルマーを穿かずに育つという、ペーソス溢れる都市伝説は本当なのかね」
lines.english: “It is perfectly serious. I recently heard a melancholy urban legend that young women today grow up without wearing bloomers. Is it true?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、逆に聞きたいんですけど、その真偽はなにか社会福祉や地域発展に貢献するんでしょうか」
lines.english: “Um, I'd like to ask you in return: would knowing the answer contribute to social welfare or regional development?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、古き良き伝統工芸をこよなく愛す、ひとりのブルマニアとしての素朴な疑問だ」
lines.english: “No. It is the innocent curiosity of one bloomer maniac devoted to that fine old traditional craft.”

lines.japanese: 「三十超えた大の男が、声高にブルマブルマ言ってる時点でぜんぜん素朴じゃないすけどね」
lines.english: “A grown man over thirty loudly going ‘bloomers, bloomers’ isn't innocent at all.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあブルマー？」
lines.english: “Then, like, bloomers?”

lines.japanese: 「や、若者風に言えばいいってことではないと思いますよ」
lines.english: “No, I don't think saying it like a young person is the point.”

lines.japanese: 「マジかなりブルマー？」
lines.english: “Like, seriously, totally bloomers?”

lines.japanese: 「無理です無理です。若者風をいくら繋げても同じですから」
lines.english: “No, no. Stringing more youthful expressions together doesn't change it.”

lines.japanese: 「でも実際、みんなは体操着ってショーパンとかハーパンだったんでしょ？　私のとこは田舎だったせいか、いまだにブルマーだったんだよね」
lines.english: “But your actual gym clothes were short shorts or longer shorts, right? Maybe because my school was out in the country, we still had bloomers.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なにっ！」
lines.english: “W-what?!”

lines.japanese: 「ほほほ本当かそれは！　う、ううう、嘘だったら承知しないぞ貴様！」
lines.english: “I-i-is that true?! I-I-I won't forgive you if you're lying!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。私に聞かれても」
lines.english: “Well, I wouldn't know. Why ask me?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿な……ひとたび体育の授業が始まれば、たちまち素人ブルマ乱れ咲きではないか。なんという破廉恥学園、聖域たる教育の現場にあって、そのような暴挙が許されていいはずはない。即刻やめさせろ！」
lines.english: “Impossible... The moment physical education began, amateur bloomers blossomed everywhere. What a shameless academy! Within the sacred precincts of education, such an outrage cannot be tolerated. End it immediately!”

lines.japanese: 「あの、アナタさっきまで、ブルマ廃止に異を唱えてませんでしたっけ」
lines.english: “Um, weren't you objecting to getting rid of bloomers a minute ago?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、たしかに……つまり端的に言えば、俺は見たいがおまえらは見るなということだよね？」
lines.english: “Indeed... Put simply, I want to look, but none of you get to. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「あの……ここで私はなんと答えればいいんでしょう」
lines.english: “Um... What am I supposed to say here?”

lines.japanese: 「あの不精ヒゲめがけておしぼり投げつければいいと思いますよ」
lines.english: “I think throwing a hand towel at that stubble would do nicely.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さんもたまにはいいこと言うんですね」
lines.english: “Even you say something worthwhile sometimes, Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「おわっ、なんか知らないけど好感度アップ！　ありがとう狩男！」
lines.english: “Whoa! No idea why, but my likability meter just went up! Thank you, Karuo!”

lines.japanese: 「鷲介！　おまえというやつは、また小さくまとまりやがって……貴様、そんなに玉泉君が怖いのか！」
lines.english: “Shuusuke! There you go settling for so little again... Are you that frightened of Tamaizumi?!”

lines.japanese: 「怖いですよ！」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: 「俺もだ！」
lines.english: “So am I!”

lines.japanese: 「知ってます！」
lines.english: “I know!”

lines.japanese: 「だが好きだ！」
lines.english: “But I like her!”

lines.japanese: 「分かります！」
lines.english: “I understand!”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なに千歳、たまひよ狙いなの？」
lines.english: “Huh? What, Chitose, you're after Tama-chick?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……なんすか英里子さん、狙いとか人聞きの悪いこと言わないでくださいよ。ほら、日和子さんが顔をしかめながらフェイドアウトしてるじゃないですか。いや、それも失礼な話だなオイ」
lines.english: “Wait... Eriko, don't say things like ‘after her.’ That sounds awful. See, Hiyoko's fading out with a frown. Actually, that's pretty rude too, hey.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、どこよ？　どこに惚れたん？　ムネか。ムネだろ」
lines.english: “What part did you fall for? The chest? It was the chest.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、おっさん的発想！　英里子さん、安直ですよ安直！」
lines.english: “Wow, what an old-man way to think! That's too simplistic, Eriko. Too simplistic!”

lines.japanese: 「でもムネだろ。ムネなんだろ」
lines.english: “But it was the chest. It was, wasn’t it?”
